public_upstream.fix_subject: avcodec/cfhd: reject transform-2 output wider than the plane (Fixes: out of array access; repro cfhd_transform2_output_width_oob.avi)

oh_source.l4_evidence: cfhd.c:969 and :1010 plane-size checks lack 'lowpass_width * 2 > s->plane[plane].width'; the similar check at :1049 is pre-existing code on another path. Both upstream fix diffs apply clean

vulnerability.summary: CFHD transform-2 output width (lowpass_width*2) is stream-controlled and unbounded by plane width; decode writes past the plane allocation — heap OOB write, triggerable during stream probing via a crafted AVI.
vulnerability.verification_level: source-level confirmed; runtime repro via upstream oss-fuzz sample name documented

notes: ffmpeg gap batch; second already_fixed false-positive root cause (stale ref ordering) fixed in l4_batch_ffmpeg.py

trigger_conditions: 带超宽 lowpass_width 的 CFHD transform-2 码流：cfhd.c:969/1010 两处平面尺寸校验未约束 lowpass_width*2 ≤ s->plane[plane].width，探测阶段即可触发堆越界写。
attack_path: 产品用 ffmpeg 解复用/探测不可信媒体（CFHD 系码流）：攻击者提供构造码流即触发越界写，无需特权，应用自动处理不可信输入时无需用户交互。
reproduction_commands: 源级三侧对照：a) 上游 db05df9d/16b2049d 修复 diff（上游样本名 cfhd_transform2_output_width_oob.avi）；b) OH 检出 cfhd.c:969/1010 均无 lowpass_width*2 校验（修复前形态）；c) 与上游 n7.1.1 逐字节一致、官方清单含 7.1.1，两 diff 对 OH 检出 git apply --check 通过。运行级路径：按样本构造码流 ASan 构建下观测越界写。
